We have a batch process in waste water and do discharge mostly 2-3 times a day at the flow rates you observe.   Durations sound about right also.  In fact we are permitted to 25L/S.  The treatment and discharge basically starts when we have filled a tank (unless it is too close to the end of shift and that water will sit over till the next morning).

Our shift pattern is 0800-1645 Monday to Friday with some OT Saturday morning.  Historically we have only discharged between those times.  Quite often we would start our first dump shortly after 0800 as it is the waste sitting over from the day before.  We have recently automated our waste water system and are looking to discharge in the evening / night.  We did our first one last evening and will be doing a few over the next couple of weeks to validate the system.  We want to discharge while the shift is not present so that the operators can start with empty tanks when they arrive at 0800.

We are happy to work collaboratively with you and manage the flow where we can.  If we are full during the day, we are going to have to dump (ideally as quickly as we can) but the automated system can potentially discharge from 1645-0800 at a time and flow rate that suits everyone.
